Shocking Blast 2: This weapon arcs with deadly electricity, dealing 2d6 Electric damage on a successful hit, and an additional 2d6 Electric damage on a critical hit.
Riposte +2: This item enchants its user with incredible awareness and speed, granting a +2 Insight bonus to AC and to Saves.
